dql.script:
fieldsAdd _l = if(contains(content, "]: "), substring(content, from: indexOf(content, "]: ") + 3), else: content)
| parse _l, "ALNUM:postfix.queue_id ': to=<'"
| parse content, "LD ' relay=' LD:postfix.relay ','"
| parse content, "LD ' delay=' DOUBLE:postfix.delay ','"
| parse content, "LD ' dsn=' LD:postfix.dsn ','"
| parse content, "LD ' status=' WORD:postfix.status SPACE? '(' DATA:postfix.reason"
| fieldsAdd postfix.relay_host = if(contains(postfix.relay, "["), substring(postfix.relay, to: indexOf(postfix.relay, "[")), else: postfix.relay),
            postfix.dsn_class = substring(postfix.dsn, to: 1),
            postfix.reason = if(endsWith(postfix.reason, ")"), substring(postfix.reason, to: stringLength(postfix.reason) - 1), else: postfix.reason)
| fieldsAdd loglevel = if(postfix.status == "deferred", "WARN", else: if(postfix.status == "bounced", "ERROR", else: loglevel))
| parse content, "LD ' to=<' LD '@' LD:postfix.to_domain '>,'"
| fieldsRemove _l, postfix.relay, postfix.to

dql.script:
parse content, "JSON:j"
| fieldsAdd postfix.event = toString(j[event]), postfix.queue = toString(j[queue]),
            postfix.queue.messages = toLong(j[messages]), postfix.queue.oldest_age_s = toLong(j[oldest_age_s]),
            postfix.dest_domain = toString(j[dest_domain])
| fieldsRemove j
